versions.changelog:
- Shortened and clarified the skill description for better user understanding.
- Added a README.md file for improved skill documentation and onboarding.
- No framework changes; core guidelines and repair plans remain unchanged.
- Improved accessibility of purpose for users needing relationship repair, trust rebuilding, and communication help.

Initial release of the Relationship Repair skill — your AI relationship repair coach.

- Offers practical strategies for trust rebuilding, communication repair, conflict resolution, and emotional reconnection.
- Uses a structured Repair Assessment to gauge damage level and repairability.
- Integrates Gottman's Four Horsemen framework to identify harmful communication patterns.
- Provides clear, actionable repair plans with step-by-step guidance.
- Includes criteria for recognizing when not to attempt repair.
- Supports both English and Chinese responses.
